    }

     * roll-forward.

     * @param registrationDate the registration date as supplied in the request, may be {@code null}
     * @throws InvalidRegistrationDateException if the date is later than the server's current date

    public static void validate(LocalDate registrationDate) {
        if (registrationDate != null && registrationDate.isAfter(LocalDate.now())) {
            throw new InvalidRegistrationDateException(registrationDate.toString(),
                "Registration date must not be later than the current date");
        }
    }
}

components:
  schemas:
    ProblemDetail:
      title: Problem Detail
      description: The schema for all error responses.
      type: object
      properties:
        type:
          title: Type
          description: Full URL that originated the error response.
          type: string
          format: uri
          example: 'http://localhost:9966/petclinic/api/owner'
          readOnly: true
        title:
          title: Title
          description: The short error title.
          type: string
          example: NoResourceFoundException
          readOnly: true
        status:
          title: Status
          description: HTTP status code
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 400
          maximum: 600
          exclusiveMaximum: true
          example: 500
          readOnly: true
        detail:
          title: Detail
          description: The long error message.
          type: string
          example: 'No static resource api/owner.'
          readOnly: true
        timestamp:
          title: Timestamp
          description: The time the error occurred.
          type: string
          format: date-time
          example: '2024-11-23T13:59:21.3820407Z'
          readOnly: true
        schemaValidationErrors:
          title: Schema validation errors
          description: Validation errors against the OpenAPI schema.
          type: array
          items:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/ValidationMessage'
      required:
        - type
        - title
        - status
        - detail
        - timestamp
        - schemaValidationErrors
    ValidationMessage:
      title: Validation message
      description: Messages describing a validation error.
      type: object
      properties:
        message:
          title: Message
          description: The validation message.
          type: string
          example: "[Path '/lastName'] Instance type (null) does not match any allowed primitive type (allowed: ['string'])"
          readOnly: true
      required:
        - message
      additionalProperties: true
    Specialty:
      title: Specialty
      description: Fields of specialty of vets.
      type: object
      properties:
        id:
          title: ID
          description: The ID of the specialty.
          type: integer
          format: int32
          minimum: 0
          example: 1
          readOnly: true
        name:
          title: Name
          description: The name of the specialty.
          type: string
          maxLength: 80
          minLength: 1
          example: radiology
      required:
        - id
        - name
    OwnerFields:
      title: Owner fields
      description: Editable fields of a pet owner.
      type: object
      properties:
        firstName:
          title: First name
          description: The first name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}$"
          example: George
        lastName:
          title: Last name
          description: The last name of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 30
          pattern: "^[\\p{L}]+([ '-][\\p{L}]+){0,2}\\.?$"
          example: Franklin
        address:
          title: Address
          description: The postal address of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 255
          example: '110 W. Liberty St.'
        city:
          title: City
          description: The city of the pet owner.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 80
          example: Madison
        telephone:
          title: Telephone number
          description: >-
            The telephone number of the pet owner, stored and returned in E.164 form. Spaces,
            dashes and brackets are removed. A leading '+' and country code are kept; otherwise
            a single leading '0' is dropped and country code '+61' is assumed. Between 8 and 15
            digits must follow the '+', e.g. '0412 345 678' is stored as '+61412345678'. Numbers
            with country code '+61' must have exactly 9 national digits and numbers with country
            code '+1' exactly 10.
          type: string
          minLength: 1
          maxLength: 20
          example: '+61412345678'
        email:
          title: Email address
          description: >-
            The optional email address of the pet owner. When present it must be a syntactically
            valid address; it is stored and returned lower-cased. An address at a disposable
            email domain (mailinator.com, tempmail.com, guerrillamail.com, or a subdomain of one)
            is rejected with 400 Bad Request.
          type: string
          format: email
          maxLength: 255
          example: 'george.franklin@example.com'
        postcode:
          title: Postcode
          description: >-
            The optional 4-digit postcode of the pet owner. When present it must be valid for the
            region of the owner's city per the fixed table NSW (Sydney) 2000-2099, VIC (Melbourne)
            3000-3099, QLD (Brisbane) 4000-4099; a postcode outside its city's range is rejected
            with 400 Bad Request. A city with no known region accepts any 4-digit postcode.
          type: string
          pattern: '^[0-9]{4}$'
          minLength: 4
          maxLength: 4
          example: '2000'

If tenure should be measured from `registrationDate` to today, it's a one-line change. Then existing owners' points would increase as time passes.
- **Household size counts the owner.** I used the stored `householdSize`, which is set when the owner is created and already includes them. So "3 or more" means the new owner plus at least two others in the household. It isn't updated later when more people join.

The only test is the acceptance case above; there are no unit tests for the household points or the level boundaries.
